about: County footprints that merge several real buildings into one block, replaced by the surveyed buildings inside them (OpenStreetMap, ODbL; cached by tools/fetch-osm-area.mjs). Heights: the mapped height in metres, or floors x 3.4 m where the mapped height is missing or clearly too low for the floor count; 'heights' overrides individual ways. Roof canopies, sky bridges and parts under 150 m2 are left out (they can't stand on the ground). 'family' (FAMILIES index in js/city-data.js) styles the replacements, 'families' individual ways.

962191-0.name: McCormick Place
962191-0.why: The County footprint merges the whole McCormick Place campus, with the roads and rail lines under it, into one 64 m block covering 753 x 833 m.
